entry.title: Canvas Zoom Integration Time Zone Issue
entry.content:
Nov 13, 07:44 PST
Resolved - This incident has been resolved.

Nov 3, 14:24 PST
Identified - We have identified an issue where Zoom meetings accessed through Canvas may show a start time that is one hour off, even when your Zoom timezone is set to “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver.”

This affects the displayed time only. If your meeting was created using the “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver” timezone, it is still scheduled at the correct time.

Workaround: To see the correct meeting times in Canvas, set your Zoom timezone to “(GMT-7:00) Arizona” when using Zoom through Canvas.

Nov 3, 10:55 PST
Update - Users accessing Zoom through Canvas may see meeting times shown in the wrong timezone. The timezone may also change on its own when the page is refreshed. We are currently investigating the issue.
In the meantime:
• When scheduling a new meeting, make sure the timezone is set to “(GMT -7:00) Pacific Time (Vancouver)” before saving.
• For meetings already scheduled, times in Canvas should display correctly as long as your Zoom timezone is set to “(GMT -7:00) Pacific Time (Vancouver).”

Nov 3, 09:24 PST
Investigating - We are currently investigating the time zone issue in Canvas Zoom integration. Users may notice inconsistent time zone displayed on the top of the web page. Please change to “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver” for correct time to join/schedule sessions.

entry.title: RogersGuest WiFi Network Service Decommissioning November 7, 2026 12:00 PT
entry.content:
Nov 7, 11:00 PST
Resolved - On November 7, 2026 at 12:00 PT the RogersGuest WiFi network was turned off at all UBC locations. This includes Vancouver (Point Grey), Robson Square, UBC Okanagan and the remote sites where it was available.

RogersGuest is a legacy hotspot service that Rogers Communications set up for its customers. It is not a UBC wireless service, and UBC and Rogers have agreed it is no longer needed.

Who is affected
Mainly Rogers customers who connect to RogersGuest while at a UBC location. UBC's own wireless networks are not affected (ubcsecure, eduroam, ubcvisitor, ubcprivate, ubcIoT).

What you need to do
If you have been using RogersGuest at UBC, please connect to one of UBC's wireless networks instead:

UBC students, faculty and staff: connect to ubcsecure with your CWL. Setup guides: it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/wireless-internet-access/wireless-internet-access-setup-documents

Visitors from eduroam member institutions: connect to eduroam with your home institution credentials.

Guests visiting: connect to ubcvisitor.

Need help?

Questions about UBC wireless: UBC IT Service Centre, it.ubc.ca/got-question-about-it-products-and-support

Questions about your Rogers WiFi service: contact Rogers at 1-855-877-WIFI (9434)
